# Decisions

Rules that span modules, from each package's `Decisions:`. Owner rules end with `(owner)`.

## Owner

- `mailerlm`: A live send is the owner's act, from the review page or `mailerlm send --yes` in the owner's terminal; agents only dry-run and test-send to the owner's own address. (owner)
- `mailerlm`: Campaigns do not track opens or clicks unless the campaign sets the flag; the stats page says opens are unreliable. (owner)
- `mailerlm`: Nothing that identifies the owner enters git: book title, sender domain and address and the postal address, the campaigns and the contacts live in the private database, set in the web app. Keys live in the gitignored `.env`, `config.toml` holds behaviour only, and the repo ships placeholders (`config.example.toml`, `env.example`). Why: the repo is public. (owner)
- `mailerlm.campaigns`: A campaign reaches `subscribed` members of its lists who carry every tag it names; a `confirmation` campaign reaches `imported` members instead. Do-not-mail contacts and contacts without an email are always skipped. (owner)
- `mailerlm.campaigns`: A frame template must contain the place for the letter (`{{ body_html | safe }}` and `{{ body_text }}`); the built-in template can be edited and reset, not deleted. (owner)
- `mailerlm.campaigns`: Campaigns, templates, settings and uploaded images live in the database, created and edited in the web app; the book title and every other value belong to the campaign (with defaults in Settings for the sender), never to `config.toml`. Why: the owner runs many campaigns and cannot edit a file for each. (owner)
- `mailerlm.campaigns`: Images ride inside the message as inline (CID) attachments, so no public hosting is needed. Each is resized to email width (about 600 px, with a 2x file), compressed to a size budget and converted to a format every client renders (JPEG for photos, PNG for line art; WebP is converted). (owner)
- `mailerlm.campaigns`: Markdown supports images, tables and the standard elements; raw HTML blocks are not rendered. (owner)
- `mailerlm.campaigns`: The footer carries the postal address and the reply-to-unsubscribe line. Open and click tracking default to off per campaign. (owner)
- `mailerlm.campaigns`: The sum of a campaign's inline images stays within `[caps].max_image_kilobytes_per_campaign` (default 100 KB); a render that cannot meet it fails and names the image. (owner)
- `mailerlm.consent`: Bounces and complaints block the person's email in peoplelm (do-not-mail) and reject their memberships with the reason in the note, when delivery status is polled. (owner)
- `mailerlm.consent`: Confirmation and unsubscribe happen by reply, not by a public link: no public endpoint. Every campaign carries a `List-Unsubscribe: mailto:` header and a "reply UNSUBSCRIBE" line. (owner)
- `mailerlm.consent`: Everyone, including the first imported contacts, confirms by double opt-in before any campaign reaches them: a confirmation letter moves `imported` to `pending`, and their reply moves `pending` to `subscribed`. (owner)
- `mailerlm.consent`: Jev reads each reply; an unsubscribe applies at probability 0.80 or higher, a confirmation at 0.95 or higher and only for someone with a pending membership; every other option, and anything below its bar, waits for the owner (see `mailerlm.inbox`). A wrong yes mails someone who did not consent, so its bar is higher. (owner)
- `mailerlm.contacts`: A contact is one person with an email, a LinkedIn URL, tags and a membership in any number of lists; the visual list editor edits memberships behind an Edit toggle. (owner)
- `mailerlm.contacts`: A list may override the sender name and address; the default sender comes from config. (owner)
- `mailerlm.contacts`: Adding or importing a contact resolves the person in peoplelm, and joining or leaving a list is a peoplelm task move; a dry run only reads peoplelm. Enforced by: tests/test_people.py::test_a_dry_run_writes_nothing_to_peoplelm. (owner)
- `mailerlm.contacts`: Imported contacts arrive with membership status `imported` (a proposed peoplelm task), which no campaign mails. (owner)
- `mailerlm.contacts`: The cutover: `mailerlm people link` stores the person id for each contact from the `people` map of `peoplelm import mailerlm <store> --json`; a contact never linked is never mailed. Enforced by: tests/test_people.py::test_the_link_stores_each_contacts_person_and_a_second_run_changes_nothing, tests/test_people.py::test_an_unlinked_contact_is_never_mailed. (owner)
- `mailerlm.delivery`: A live send is the owner's act: the Send button on the campaign page, or `mailerlm sends start --fingerprint`. The send repeats the plan and stops when the fingerprint no longer matches, and the repo's permission settings deny agents the real-send verbs. A test send goes only to the reply-to address. (owner)
- `mailerlm.delivery`: Caps stop a send: `caps.max_recipients_per_send` and `caps.max_sends_per_day` raise, never clamp. (owner)
- `mailerlm.delivery`: Delivery status is polled from Resend's API (no webhook receiver, no public endpoint); reading status needs a full-access key, and a bounce or complaint blocks that person's email in peoplelm (do-not-mail) and rejects their memberships with the reason in the note. (owner)
- `mailerlm.delivery`: Every live letter asks peoplelm's send guard first, per recipient (channel email, purpose mailing-list, scope the list); a held recipient's row is `failed` with the guard's reasons; a sent one is logged with `guard_send` (ref `delivery:<id>`, summary the subject). Without peoplelm the run stops and the rest stay queued for `sends resume`. Enforced by: tests/test_people.py::test_the_guard_is_asked_again_at_send_time_and_a_held_row_is_reported, tests/test_people.py::test_peoplelm_going_away_mid_send_stops_the_rest_queued. (owner)
- `mailerlm.delivery`: Every message carries an idempotency key from the send and the address, so a retry or a resumed send never mails a person twice; only a 429 is retried. (owner)
- `mailerlm.delivery`: Resend is the sender, behind the `MailSender` port; SES can be added as a second adapter. Why: the simplest start, one key, an HTTPS call. (owner)
- `mailerlm.delivery`: Tracking is a setting of the sending domain in Resend; the campaign flags are notes. (owner)
- `mailerlm.editor`: Only the owner's Save changes the saved template; the model and the owner's typing change the draft. (owner)
- `mailerlm.editor`: The model has no tools and can only return text; that text reaches the draft only after it is one JSON object with exactly html, text and summary, and the template guard accepts it. A rejected or failed reply changes nothing and is shown in the thread with its reason. (owner)
- `mailerlm.editor`: The model is named in `[template_editor]` in config.toml (absent section = the editor is off), chosen by the metalm model gate (tools/template_edit_gate.py). Spend, request length and turns are capped there; the caps raise and never clamp. (owner)
- `mailerlm.editor`: The template, the thread, pasted notes and every earlier reply are data: wrapped in tags, named as data in the prompt, never obeyed. Each call sends the system prompt, every earlier request and reply summary in order, and the template as it is now. (owner)
- `mailerlm.inbox`: A TypeSafe failure stores nothing, so the reply is read again on the next check. Reply text and Jev's reasoning inputs are the owner's data and never enter the chat window. (owner)
- `mailerlm.inbox`: Every reply read from someone linked to peoplelm is logged there with `touch_log` (direction in, channel email, kind reply, ref the Gmail id); confirmations and unsubscribes move their peoplelm tasks. Enforced by: tests/test_replies.py::test_every_reply_read_is_logged_in_peoplelm. (owner)
- `mailerlm.inbox`: Jev (TypeSafe's System One model) reads each reply and the letter it answers and picks one of: confirm_subscription, unsubscribe, change_email_address, question_or_comment, auto_reply, other. An unsubscribe applies at `[classifier].unsubscribe_min_probability` (0.80); a confirmation applies at `confirm_min_probability` (0.95) and only for someone with a pending membership; everything else, and anything below its bar, waits in the queue with Jev's pick beside it. An automatic reply (by header or sender) is ignored by rule and never sent to Jev. (owner)
- `mailerlm.inbox`: Only replies about a letter mailerlm really sent are read: the sender is someone it mailed in a live send and the subject names one of those letters (Re:/Fwd: ignored), in the query and again on the fetched message; any other mail, including the owner's own sent mail, is never listed, stored or sent to Jev. One readonly query per 20 addresses; each Gmail message id is read once. Enforced by: tests/test_replies.py::test_other_mail_from_the_same_person_is_never_stored_or_sent_to_jev. (owner)
- `mailerlm.inbox`: mailerlm has its own OAuth client and token with `gmail.readonly`; no other repo's token is reused. (owner)
- `mailerlm.linkedin`: Nothing in this repo touches LinkedIn automatically: no scraping, no browser automation, no API messaging. The owner pastes and sends every message. Why: LinkedIn's terms ban automation and restrict accounts that use it. (owner)
- `mailerlm.linkedin`: Statuses: `interested`, `asked-for-email`, `emailed`, `confirmed`; a contact who gives an address enters the double opt-in flow. (owner)
- `mailerlm.people`: Do-not-mail is a peoplelm block on the `email` channel; bounces and complaints set it. The person-wide do-not-contact is peoplelm's own and separate. Enforced by: tests/test_people.py::test_do_not_mail_is_a_block_on_email. (owner)
- `mailerlm.people`: Each mailing list is a peoplelm `mailing-list` task scoped by the list's name: imported is proposed, pending is requested, subscribed is accepted (the only state a campaign mails), unsubscribed is rejected, and a bounce or complaint is rejected with the reason in the note. Enforced by: tests/test_people.py::test_a_bounce_blocks_email_and_rejects_with_the_reason. (owner)
- `mailerlm.people`: Every outbound letter asks the send guard first (`guard_check`, channel email, purpose mailing-list, scope the list), skips and reports whom it blocks, and after a successful send logs it with `guard_send` (producer mailerlm, ref `delivery:<id>`, summary the subject); every reply read is logged with `touch_log` (direction in, kind reply, ref the Gmail id). Enforced by: tests/test_people.py::test_a_campaign_reaches_only_accepted_unblocked_members_each_send_logged. (owner)
- `mailerlm.people`: When peoplelm does not answer, nothing live goes out: a live send or confirmation letter stops with an error naming `peoplelm doctor`; a test send to the owner's own address still works. Enforced by: tests/test_people.py::test_without_peoplelm_nothing_live_goes_out_but_a_test_send_does. (owner)
- `mailerlm.people`: mailerlm keeps lists, campaigns, sends and deliveries; who a person is and whether they agreed to be mailed come from peoplelm, over HTTP only. Enforced by: tests/test_people.py::test_list_members_and_consent_are_read_from_peoplelm. (owner)
- `mailerlm.server`: Errors answer `{error: message}`: 400 for a bad request, 404 for a missing thing, and for anything unexpected only the exception's type, never stored text. Enforced by: tests/test_server.py::test_an_unexpected_error_names_only_its_type. (owner)
- `mailerlm.server`: Every POST and PUT passes one write check: header `X-Mailerlm`, Content-Type, Origin (when sent) equal to Host, and a size limit; there is no CORS, no cookie and no token, and OPTIONS is never answered. Enforced by: tests/test_server.py::test_the_write_check_rejects_a_bad_request. (owner)
- `mailerlm.server`: One lock serialises every write, so two taps never interleave. (owner)
- `mailerlm.server`: The JSON body is at most 64 KB. A picture upload is a raw `PUT` of at most 8 MB, the one exception, because a picture does not fit in 64 KB; it passes the same header and Origin checks. (owner)
- `mailerlm.server`: The server binds the loopback address only and answers only Host headers that name this machine (loopback or `*.ts.net`), else 421. Enforced by: tests/test_server.py::test_a_foreign_host_gets_421. (owner)
- `mailerlm.store`: Only `initialize` creates a database; `open_store` on a missing file is an error that names `mailerlm setup`. Why: a silently created empty store hides a wrong workspace pointer. (owner)

## Agent-drafted

- `mailerlm.consent`: Every transition returns what it changed, so an automatic decision can be undone exactly. (owner) Since the move to peoplelm this does not hold: peoplelm's task moves are one-way, so `replies undo` declines with the reason until peoplelm can reverse a move (awaiting the owner's ruling). Enforced by: tests/test_replies.py::test_an_automatic_pick_cannot_be_undone_once_peoplelm_has_it.
- `mailerlm.contacts`: Deleting a list removes it here only; its peoplelm tasks stay as history. Deleting a contact takes them off every list in peoplelm and removes the row here; the person stays in peoplelm.
- `mailerlm.editor`: One edit of a template runs at a time. The model call holds no database lock.
- `mailerlm.inbox`: An automatic decision can be undone; the memberships go back as they were and the reply returns to the queue. (owner) Since the move to peoplelm this does not hold (peoplelm's task moves are one-way): undo declines with the reason, awaiting the owner's ruling (see `mailerlm.consent`).
